Congress Leader Detained, Visits Ram Temple Amid Donation Controversy

Congress leader Ajay Rai was reportedly detained for several hours before being allowed to visit the Ram Temple in Ayodhya. This occurred amidst allegations of a donation scam at the temple. Rai claimed the administration politicized his religious visit, while his wife alleged the BJP would be responsible if anything happened to him. The incident has drawn attention to the temple's financial dealings.
